problem.title: Find the Lowest Internal Node
problem.problemStatement: Given a binary tree, determine the deepest node that is not a leaf. If multiple such nodes exist, return the leftmost one.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the binary tree.
problem.output: • Print the value of the required node.
